name: temp-editor
title: Temp Editor
description: A temporary text input window for composing text and copying it to the clipboard. Useful for avoiding IME cursor issues in vim, tmux/zellij, and CLI-based LLMs, or writing multi-line terminal commands with proper IME support.
author: okash1n

commands.name: index
commands.title: Temp Editor
commands.description: Open a temporary text input window. Compose text with full IME support, then copy to clipboard for pasting into terminals, vim, or LLM prompts.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
